content_zh:
这飞针技术简直了！
当下, 病人抽搐的更厉害, 苏檀将针快速扎入她的人中和虎口进行急救，针扎下去后, 病人的手指动了动, 已有苏醒迹象, 苏檀这才握起她的手腕, 为她把脉。
“这……她到底是怎么了？”周晓霞和同学们在一旁跟着着急。
苏檀没做声, 拿起银针对准病人的肚皮, 正要扎下去，却被人猛地推开。
抬眼看去，一个戴茶色眼镜的中年女人, 正怒瞪着苏檀, 没好气道：
“你在干什么？急救这种事，你一个中医凑什么热闹？再说，你会针灸吗？你保证你能扎准穴位？如果出事情该怎么办？你能负责？”
苏檀眉头紧蹙，没来得及说话，就见眼镜女双手交叠，按压着病人的胸口为她做急救。
一番急救后，病人呻-吟几声。
“果然还是西医厉害！”
“急救还是需要西医啊！中医果然不行……”
众人议论纷纷。
眼镜女对苏檀哼了一声：
“人命关天的大事，可不是你随便逞能的，再说了，你没看见病人的肚子吗？”
大家都盯着病人的肚子，哪怕是躺在地上，病人肚子的隆起也很明显，看样子是要临盆了，如果刚才那针扎的稍有差错，就会一尸两命，这可不是开玩笑的事。
再说这个小姑娘年纪轻轻，中医这行但凡有些名气的，哪个不是白发苍苍的？她一个小姑娘能懂什么针灸？应该也是半吊子吧？这种水平如果扎下去……
大家不禁后怕。
眼镜女继续教训道：“病人明显是孕妇，你竟然对着她的肚子扎针，你怎么想的？”
大家闻言，纷纷点头，附和女人的说法，想想也是，这小姑娘实在是不知轻重，就算是中医，也不能对着孕妇的肚子扎针吧？
苏檀却不恼，只嘴角微勾，轻笑道：“谁告诉你她是孕妇的？”
“这还用告诉？你没看到病人的肚子都这么大了吗？以我多年的经验，她至少有38周了。”

围观群众纷纷附和：
“确实月份不小了。”
“我儿媳妇跟她肚子差不多大，39周了。”
“应该是二胎吧？看她大儿子都五六岁了。”
见大家附和自己，女人扫了她一眼，冷哼一声：“一看你就是没生过孩子的！这肚子放在这，还需要告诉？明显是要临盆了。”
苏檀勾唇：“是不是怀孕了，你可以直接问当事人。”
当下，躺在地上的女人艰难地睁开眼，围观群众有的为她撑伞遮阳，有的给她扇扇子，还有拿冰块给她降温的。
病人醒来，眼镜女连忙问：“你还好吧？救护车马上就到了，要坚强！就算是为了肚子里的孩子，也得撑下去！”
病人一愣，半晌才道：“怀孕？你在说什么？我没怀孕。”
“没怀孕？”眼镜女愣了一下，明显不信。
这病人三十岁出头的样子，身材稍显丰腴，但绝对算不上胖，可她的肚子却高高隆起，像是要临盆一样，任谁看了她都会认为她就要生了，怎么可能没怀孕呢？
病人把一旁哭泣的孩子拉到怀里，捂着胸口说：
“我没怀孕，就是肚子大，气短，一动就喘，今天太热了，我被太阳一晒，不知怎的就两眼一闭晕倒了。”
这话一出，眼镜女的脸上闪过一丝红云，刚才她信誓旦旦说病人怀孕了，现在倒好，当众打脸，人家根本没怀孕，可这没道理啊，正常人，肚子大如临盆，怎么看都不正常。
“你没去看过医生？”
“看过。”病人气若游丝：“做过很多次检查，都查不出问题。”
眼镜女又蹙眉：“那就换一家医院！你这肚子很不正常啊！”
围观群众纷纷点头，转而又疑惑地看向苏檀，刚才这姑娘直言病人没有怀孕，她是怎么做到的？难不成是把脉把出来的？若真是如此，这小姑娘的医术可不简单，毕竟就是老中医，也未必能做到这点。

content_en:
This flying needle technology is simply amazing!
At that moment, the patient's convulsions became more severe. Su Tan quickly inserted the needle into her vagina and tiger's mouth for first aid. After the needle was inserted, the patient's fingers moved and there were signs of waking up. Su Tan then held her wrist and felt her pulse.
"What...what happened to her?" Zhou Xiaoxia and her classmates were worried.
Su Tan said nothing, picked up the silver needle and aimed it at the patient's belly. Just as he was about to pierce it, he was suddenly pushed away.
Looking up, a middle-aged woman wearing brown glasses was glaring at Su Tan and said angrily:
"What are you doing? Why are you, a Chinese medicine doctor, joining in the fun of first aid? Besides, can you do acupuncture? Are you sure you can hit the right acupuncture points? What should I do if something goes wrong? Can you be responsible?"
Su Tan frowned. Before she could speak, she saw the bespectacled woman folding her hands and pressing the patient's chest to give her first aid.
After some first aid, the patient groaned several times.
“As expected, Western medicine is still amazing!”
"First aid still requires Western medicine! Traditional Chinese medicine is really not good..."
Everyone was talking about it.
The bespectacled woman snorted to Su Tan:
"It's a matter of life and death, and it's not something you can show off casually. Besides, didn't you see the patient's belly?"
Everyone is staring at the patient's belly. Even when he is lying on the ground, the bulge of the patient's belly is obvious. It seems that he is about to give birth. If the needle was inserted slightly wrong just now, one person will die and two people will die. This is no joke.
Besides, this little girl is young, and among those who are somewhat famous in the field of Chinese medicine, who is not gray-haired? What can a little girl like her know about acupuncture? He must be half-assed, right? If this level persists...
Everyone couldn't help but be afraid.
The bespectacled woman continued to lecture: "The patient is obviously a pregnant woman, and you actually inserted an needle into her belly. What do you think?"
After hearing this, everyone nodded and agreed with the woman's statement. Thinking about it, this little girl really doesn't know the importance. Even a Chinese medicine doctor can't insert an needle into the belly of a pregnant woman, right?
Su Tan was not annoyed. She only slightly raised the corners of her mouth and chuckled, "Who told you that she is pregnant?"
"Do you need to tell me? Haven't you seen that the patient's belly is so big? Based on my many years of experience, she is at least 38 weeks old."
The onlookers all echoed:
"It's true that the month is not small."
"My daughter-in-law's belly is about the same size as hers, and she is 39 weeks old."
"It must be the second child, right? Her eldest son is already five or six years old."
Seeing everyone agreeing with her, the woman glanced at her and snorted: "You have never given birth! With your belly here, do you still need to tell me? You are obviously about to give birth."
Su Tan raised her lips and said, "You can ask the person involved directly if she is pregnant."
At that moment, the woman lying on the ground struggled to open her eyes. Some of the onlookers held umbrellas to protect her from the sun, some fanned her, and some brought ice cubes to cool her down.
When the patient woke up, the bespectacled woman quickly asked: "Are you okay? The ambulance will be here soon. Be strong! You have to hold on even for the sake of the child in your belly!"
The patient was stunned for a while and then said: "Pregnant? What are you talking about? I'm not pregnant."
"Not pregnant?" The girl with glasses was stunned for a moment, obviously not believing it.
The patient was in her early thirties, with a slightly plump figure, but definitely not fat. However, her belly was bulging as if she was about to give birth. Anyone who looked at her would think that she was about to give birth. How could she not be pregnant?
The patient pulled the crying child into his arms, covered his chest and said:
"I'm not pregnant, but I have a big belly, shortness of breath, and I gasp when I move. It's too hot today. When I was exposed to the sun, I closed my eyes and fainted for some reason."
As soon as these words came out, a trace of red cloud flashed on the face of the bespectacled girl. Just now she swore that the patient was pregnant, but now it's better to slap her in the face in public. She is not pregnant at all, but this doesn't make sense. A normal person's belly is as big as giving birth., it’s not normal no matter how you look at it.
"You haven't seen a doctor?"
"I've seen it." The patient said angrily, "I've had many tests and couldn't find any problems."
The bespectacled woman frowned again: "Then find another hospital! Your stomach is very abnormal!"
The onlookers nodded, and then looked at Su Tan with confusion. Just now, the girl bluntly stated that the patient was not pregnant. How did she do it? Could it be that he felt his pulse? If this is the case, this little girl's medical skills are not simple. After all, even an experienced Chinese doctor may not be able to do this.
